SiteBranding.title: SiteBranding
SiteBranding.description: Global website branding and trademark logo configuration persisted across sessions.

logoUrl.description: Public URL or self-contained Data URI of the active website trademark logo.

storageUrl.description: Optional Firebase Storage or server static URL for the uploaded logo.

fileName.description: Original filename of the uploaded logo.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the logo image.

updatedBy.description: UID or identifier of the administrator who updated the logo.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator document for role-based access control.

/site_settings/{settingId}.description: Global site settings and branding configuration documents (e.g. /site_settings/branding).

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted administrator registry for RBAC verification.
